articles.title: North Dallas Bank & Trust (NODB) Stock Stalls As Q3 Results Meet Funding Scrutiny
articles.summary: North Dallas Bank & Trust has a reputation as a quietly efficient community lender, yet Q3 2026 results landed with zero drama in the share price. The stock closed flat at $66.50, even as quarterly net income came in at about $2.6 million and basic earnings per share printed at $1.01.
